owner_direction_ru: Главный приоритет — качество и автономность JANUS, а не количество устранённых зависимостей. Не будем изобретать заново то, что уже эффективно работает. Собственные механизмы будем разрабатывать там, где они действительно дают преимущество.

decisions.pytorch: permitted, primary research training backend where effective; no forced removal
decisions.native_core: optional verified alternative, numerical parity reference and portable fallback research; no automatic production rollout
decisions.external_libraries: permitted when compatible with GitHub-only operation, security, provenance, reproducibility and measured quality
decisions.evaluation: judge task competence, retention, verified learning, runtime reliability, CPU cost and autonomy; do not use dependency count as proxy
decisions.promotion: unchanged fail-closed retention and independent exam requirements
decisions.next_research: diagnose R1.16 item-level retention bottlenecks and compare protected-subspace gradient projection to existing rollback on matched compute, with fresh held-out generation exam; do not loosen veto or change production

limits: Recorded on research registry branch, not merged into production policy
R1.17 parity is limited to three float64 evaluation-mode training steps, finite differences and two generation probes; no speed superiority or broad learning proof
Native fallback still requires separate runtime integration and checkpoint admission before use
